# Streams for TestStreams. Columns: file, order, memory in bytes, restoration method (0 restart, 1 cut off,
# 2 freeze), size and SHA-256 of the decoded data, minimum number of model events the stream must cause
# (restarts, cut-offs, steps of the frozen model), source of the stream.
#
# Sources (none of them is FreeArc's 64-bit build, whose model diverges from real archives once memory fills):
#   7z     p7zip 17.05 "7z a -tzip -mm=PPMd -mmem=1m -mo=<order> -mx=<5: r0 | 7: r1> z.zip mix.bin" (7-Zip's Ppmd8,
#          32-bit layout, ZIP method 98); the 2-byte header (order-1, memory MB-1, restoration method) is removed
#   ppmd8  the Ppmd8 sources of 7-Zip (github.com/ip7z/7zip main, C/Ppmd8*.c dated 2023) built with PPMD8_FREEZE_SUPPORT and with the
#          "rev.2" fix in Refresh() (scale |= SummFreq >= 1<<15) removed, which makes it PPMd var.I rev.1 as FreeArc's
#          code is; driven by a 30-line encoder that writes the end marker and flushes like the ZIP encoder
#   fagen  FreeArc's own encoder, valid only while the model memory does not fill up (the tests check it)
#
# Inputs: mix.bin (400000 bytes) = 160000 bytes of C/C++ source text, 30000 random bytes, 20000 zeros, 100000 bytes of
# other source text, 40000 bytes of a repeated 23-byte record, 50000 random bytes over an alphabet of 4 letters.
# small30k.txt = the first 30000 bytes of a concatenation of C++ sources. t28k.txt = 28000 bytes of the same text.
# Only the SHA-256 of the inputs is kept here.
